_comment: How Nookworks' kitchen and Farmer's Delight's meet (compat/farmersdelight/KitchenSettings). twins: the same food in both mods; any recipe asking for one by id takes either. prefer: whose twin a furnace, smoker, blast furnace or campfire gives when both mods have a recipe there for the same thing (farmersdelight or nookworks). pan: Farmer's Delight Cooking Pot recipes our Frying Pan cooks in its oil, rather than the Iron Pot in water. not_crossed: recipes of either mod never brought to the other's pot. bakery_stands_down / no_wheat_bread_stands_down: its recipes that stand down while the flour bakery is on / while bread is not made from wheat - both empty: its own cake and bread stay whatever our settings are (the owner, 2026-11-17: having Nookworks installed never makes another mod less convenient); a pack that wants them gone lists them here. water and oil: mB a serving of its dishes takes in our pot or pan; experience: what ours give in its pot.
